text:
Maya (eng-oncall): PagerDuty triggered for p99 SLO burn in eu-west, grabbing it now.
PagerDuty: [INC-230102] p99 latency SLO > 2000ms (red) — auto-page to eng-oncall.
IncidentBot: automatic alert: p99 latency over threshold for service: inference-gateway (route: /v1/generate).
Maya (eng-oncall): Observed spike at 23:24 UTC, p95 ~ 650ms -> p99 ~ 2.6s. Customers may see slow responses.
Alex R.: Confirming in graphs — sudden tail at 23:23:40 across 3 hosts in eu-west pool. CPU okay, GPU util up ~10%, but GPU mem pressure rising.
Lin: Any recent deploys? I don't see a code deploy in the window. Autoscaler events?
Priya: No deploys. Autoscaler shows a failed scale-up at 23:22 due to quota, returned 403 to cloud provider.
Sam: That matches: some requests queued, continuous batching increased latency. If scale-up failed we hit higher queue depth -> tail latency.
Maya (eng-oncall): Ok, quick customer-impact check — which customers hit SLO? Querying logs for 5xx and latency >1.5s.
Maya (eng-oncall): (results) 12 active API keys with >50% requests over 1500ms, mostly small customers on dedicated pools in eu-west. No 5xx spike.
Alex R.: Good that errors are low. Mitigation options: 1) force-fallback to lower-capacity model variant in eu-west routing, 2) increase routing to other regions (eu-central) with spare capacity, 3) temporary autoscaler fallback policy (burst from reserved).
Lin: Can we enable cross-region overflow for this customer cohort? We have cross-region routing but some keys pinned to eu-west.
Priya: We can temporarily unpin select API keys — requires manual config change in routing service. I can change for top affected keys.
Maya (eng-oncall): Priya — do that for keys: key-84*, key-91* and key-77* — those are highest latency. Also trigger fallback to model-variant: redwood-v1-small for non-sensitive keys.
Priya: On it. Making config change now.
IncidentBot: Config update: routing.unpin keys applied by Priya at 23:27:05 UTC.
Sam: Rolling out model fallback to redwood-v1-small for non-sensitive keys (canary). Patch in rollout service: `PATCH /rollouts/active` -> enabling fallback.
PagerDuty: INC-230102 acknowledged by Maya (eng-oncall).
Alex R.: While that propagates, we should open a quick pager rotation handoff in case this goes long. Maya, can you stay for initial mitigation?
Maya (eng-oncall): I can take lead for next 30m then hand to Lin.
Lin: I'll be on deck after that.
Priya: Cross-region unpin and fallback applied for 9 keys; latency dropping for those customers.
Maya (eng-oncall): Metrics: p99 for affected keys down from 2.6s -> 1.1s after routing changes. Overall p99 still ~1.9s due to remaining pinned flows.
Alex R.: Good improvement. Next: check autoscaler quota failure root cause — cloud provider returned `QuotaExceeded` for `n1-gpu` at 23:22. We should contact cloud ops and enable temporary burst.
Sam: As a hotfix, we can enable local KV cache TTL extension to reduce token compute for repeated prefixes — quick config: `cache.prefix_ttl = 45s`. That will reduce forward passes for conversation continuations.
Maya (eng-oncall): Apply cache TTL tweak for eu-west only, set to 45s.
IncidentBot: Config update: serving.cache.prefix_ttl set to 45s in eu-west by Sam at 23:30:12 UTC.
Priya: Autoscaler request retried and succeeded at 23:31:00 — 2 new nodes came up. GPU mem freed and queue drained.
Alex R.: Now seeing p99 drop to 850ms cluster-wide. SLO burn trending down.
Maya (eng-oncall): Customer impact summary: transient slow responses for ~9k requests/min over 9 minutes. No errors, no data loss. Affected: primarily eu-west small dedicated pools with pinned routing.
Lin: Action items: 1) Cloud quota follow-up with infra to prevent future scale-up failures, 2) add autoscaler retry/backoff metrics to alert earlier, 3) update routing policy to allow emergency cross-region overflow by default for non-EU-data-residency keys.
Sam: I'll open infra ticket for quota.
Priya: I'll prepare a short post-incident note for support with affected API keys and mitigation steps.
Maya (eng-oncall): Handing lead to Lin at 23:33 UTC. Lin, you're primary; I'll remain reachable.
Lin: Taking over. If anything re-fires ping @Lin.
PagerDuty: INC-230102 reassigned to Lin.
Maya (eng-oncall): Thanks team. Final check: add follow-up to retro board and label severity: Sev3 (SLO burn, no customer downtime).
Alex R.: Agreed.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-230102 status: mitigated -> monitoring (23:36 UTC).
Maya (eng-oncall): Closing thread here; moving notes to incidents repo and support playbook.
Lin: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Priya: Good job, quick and clean.
Sam: leaving a short runbook patch PR for cache TTL and emergency routing.
Maya (eng-oncall): End of thread.
